packing.pageTitle: Marble & Granite Packing | Safe Export Packing for Slabs & Tiles – Wadi Degla
packing.metaDescription: Discover Wadi Degla's professional packing solutions for marble and granite slabs and tiles. Export-grade wooden crates, bundles, and pallets designed for maximum protection during global shipping.
packing.woodenBundleText:
Slabs are grouped in bundles of 8–15 pieces depending on thickness. Each bundle is secured using reinforced wooden frames and loaded into 20-foot containers using overhead cranes.
Polished surfaces are protected with plastic sheets to prevent any scratches during transit.
packing.normalPackingText:
For manual loading, slabs are placed directly inside the container on wooden bars for stabilization.
Long slabs are arranged in two large groups, while shorter slabs are arranged in four compact groups to ensure balanced container weight.
Plastic sheets are added between polished faces to prevent friction damage.
packing.woodenCratesText:
Tiles are selected, sorted, and placed inside wooden crates lined with foam for shock absorption.
Each crate is labeled with the tile size, thickness, and order details.
Small and delicate tiles (such as 12"x12") are additionally packed inside Styrofoam boxes.
packing.woodenPalletText:
Large tiles are packed on high-strength wooden pallets wrapped with plastic and strapped with rubber-protected belts to avoid chipping.
Each pallet includes a detailed label containing the tile count, dimensions, and thickness.
packing.benefit1: Export-grade wooden bundles, crates, and pallets
packing.benefit2: Foam and plastic protection for polished and delicate surfaces
packing.benefit3: Balanced loading to prevent impact stress
packing.benefit4: Clear labeling for fast customs clearance
packing.benefit5: Secure strapping to avoid shifting during sea shipment
packing.benefit6: Proven performance across Africa, Europe, Asia, GCC, and North/South America
packing.ctaTitle: Request Professional Packing for Your Order
packing.ctaDescription: We help you choose the right packing solution depending on your shipping destination, climate, and container type.

history.pageTitle: Wadi Degla History — Three Generations of Egyptian Marble Excellence
history.metaDescription: Discover the heritage of Wadi Degla, a family legacy shaping Egypt's marble and quarrying industry since 1980. From Galala Mountain to global markets, explore the true story behind one of Egypt's leading stone suppliers.
history.heroAlt: Historic Egyptian marble quarry — early days of Wadi Degla family operations
history.visionTitle: A Vision That Redefined an Industry
history.firstGenIntro: Since 1951, the Alghanam family has been closely tied to Egypt's natural stone industry. Their early involvement in quarrying laid the foundation for what would later become one of the country's most influential marble enterprises. With ambition passed down through generations, the family established Wadi Degla in 1980 — a turning point that marked the beginning of a new era in Egyptian marble production.
history.visionaryBeginningsText: The true turning point in our family’s journey came in 1980 with the ambition of our founder, Alhag Saed Alghanam. Determined to master the art and science of quarrying, he immersed himself in the craft, learning everything from extraction techniques to material quality. His curiosity led him to the iconic Galala Mountain, a site previously unknown for its marble potential. Taking a tremendous risk, he opened the first Galala quarry, uncertain of the mountain’s capacity or commercial value. History would prove their instincts right: Galala marble soon became one of Egypt’s most prized resources, drawing visits and praise from the world’s largest importers of raw material blocks. Encouraged by the success of the Galala quarry, Alhag Saed Alghanam continued to explore new sites, founding the Zafraana, Samaha, and Sunny Elsheikh Fadl quarries. Over time, the Alghanam family secured more than 50 active quarries—Wadi Degla under Alhag Saed Alghanam leadership owned 7 quarries of them across the Galala mountain alone. This extensive quarry network allowed us to supply to top exporter in Egypt; they were the first to show the whole world the Galala marble, elevating our country’s standing in monumental projects around the globe.
history.secondGenText: As the quarries grew, Alhag Sameh Alghanam gained deep hands-on experience working alongside his father. In 2000, the family opened its first manufacturing facility, expanding operations from quarrying into full-scale fabrication.
history.thirdGenTitle: The Rise of a New Generation
history.thirdGenText: When Saed Alghanam, the third generation, stepped in, he brought a modern vision and global perspective. Starting his journey at age 11 in the quarries and factories, he learned the craft directly from his father and grandfather. By 2024, Saed founded Wadi Degla Global Exporting, dedicated to showcasing Egyptian marble internationally. New Milestones Under Saed's Leadership: 1. Opening the Creamy White Pearl Quarry in Sinai - a brighter, exclusive variation of Galala marble. 2. Expanding exports to Latin America, Europe, and Africa. 3. Positioning Wadi Degla as a trusted supplier for luxury hotels and mega-projects. 4. Introducing modern branding and a global distribution approach.
history.legacyText1: Throughout our history, the Alghanam family has produced numerous influential figures who have all played pivotal roles in securing and shaping Egypt’s quarrying industry. This passion has been passed down through generations—it's in our veins.
history.legacyText2: In tribute to our rich history, we proudly share photographs of Alhag Saed Alghanam from the 1980s and 1990s, both in Egyptian quarries and abroad—particularly in Turkey, where he explored international partnerships. These images symbolize our ongoing commitment to excellence, tradition, and global collaboration.
history.finalText1: Decades of expertise and a deep commitment to quality have placed Wadi Degla and the Alghanam family at the forefront of the marble and granite industry. As we expand globally, we remain true to the principles that shaped our beginnings:
history.finalText2:
• Respect for natural resources
• Dedication to craftsmanship
• Visionary leadership
• A relentless pursuit of excellence
history.firstBreakthroughText: The true transformation began when Alhag Saed Alghanam dared to explore the then-unknown potential of the Galala Mountain. With no certainty about the stone quality or commercial value, he opened the first Galala quarry — a move that proved historic. Galala marble soon became one of Egypt's most sought-after stone materials, attracting importers from around the world.
history.familyExpansionText: Inspired by early success, the Alghanam family established additional quarries including Zafraana, Samaha, and Sunny Elsheikh Fadl. Over the decades, the family secured more than 50 active quarries across key locations in Egypt. Under Alhag Saed's leadership, Wadi Degla owned seven major quarries in Galala alone, transforming the region into one of the most prestigious marble sources in the world.
history.firstGenAlt: Alhag Saed Alghanam—first-generation leadership in Wadi Degla
history.secondGenAlt: Sameh Alghanam—second-generation leadership in Wadi Degla
history.secondGenPartnershipText: Alhag Sameh built strategic partnerships with major Chinese stone distributors, reinforcing Wadi Degla's influence in international markets. By 2011, the second factory was launched, followed by the development of seven more quarries on Galala Mountain — scaling output to meet rising global demand.

history.legacyIntroText: Across generations, the Alghanam family has produced influential figures who played a pivotal role in preserving Egypt's quarrying heritage. Their dedication ensured that Egyptian marble gained global recognition while maintaining authenticity, tradition, and craftsmanship.

kerbstone.pageTitle: Egyptian Kerbstone Supplier | Granite & Limestone Curbstone | Wadi Degla Marble
kerbstone.metaDescription: Premium Egyptian granite and limestone kerbstones for roads, sidewalks, landscapes, and heavy-duty applications. Explore kerb types, sizes, finishes, and export options from Wadi Degla Marble.
kerbstone.introText1: Kerbstones manufactured by Wadi Degla are crafted from durable Egyptian granite and limestone, designed for roads, pedestrian walkways, landscaping, highways, and large-scale infrastructure projects.
kerbstone.introText2: Our kerb stones are weather-resistant, long-lasting, and available in several profiles and finishes suitable for various applications.

str.title: STR KERBSTONE
str.text: Identical in design with T-kerb with an integrated drainage system. The surface water of the road is kept away from the level crossing and can seep into the ground. Quick installation in combination with standard foundations from STR.

fullBatter.title: FULL BATTER KERBSTONE
fullBatter.text: Used where a vehicle may need to ride up onto a verge in an emergency; for safety reasons these are not used when a footpath is present. Where a crossing is required for access to a private driveway, access point or pedestrian crossing, the appropriate tapers and crossing kerbs are used.

bullnose.title: BULLNOSE KERBSTONE
bullnose.text: Precision-manufactured and durable bullnose kerbs for highway and city developments that meet strict guidelines and withstand heavy traffic.

roundTop.title: ROUND TOP GARDEN EDGE
roundTop.text: Wadi Degla's round top garden edging is the perfect finishing touch to any garden or pathway, helping to create distinct areas and guiding visitors in the direction you choose. Available in many neutral colours, this edging will suit any paving from our collection.

channel.title: CHANNEL KERBSTONE
channel.text: Stone Drainage Channels are often used to create a holistic and complete expression when using granite in outdoor facilities. The gutters are available in head, middle and end pieces and help control water flow and runoff.

transition.title: TRANSITION KERBSTONE
transition.text: A transition kerb enables vehicles to cross the public pavement to access a private driveway while indicating to the driver that they are leaving the lane. Often used to border traffic islands and pedestrian crossing aids.

kerbstone.finalText1: To create a boundary and maintain a clean edge for your driveway, kerb stones add both functionality and visual appeal to your outdoor space. Beyond providing a stylish finishing touch, kerb stones and block paving edging play a vital role in the overall design of your driveway.
kerbstone.finalText2: At WADI DEGLA, we offer a wide range of high-quality kerb stones, crafted for strength, durability, and elegance. Available in various colors, textures, sizes, and designs, our kerb stones seamlessly complement any driveway project—whether in a modern or traditional setting.
kerbstone.finalText3: We provide standard sizes, but our factory is fully equipped to produce custom dimensions to meet your specific requirements. We manufacture diverse product models and are ready to deliver bespoke designs with the necessary dimensions, finishes, and materials.

machinery.pageTitle: Wadi Degla Machinery | Advanced Marble & Granite Production Equipment in Egypt
machinery.metaDescription: Explore Wadi Degla's state-of-the-art marble and granite machinery, including gangsaws, block cutters, polishing lines, monofilos, bridge cutters, tumbling machines, and more. Precision-engineered production for slabs, tiles, and blocks—trusted by global importers and mega-projects.
machinery.intro:
At Wadi Degla Marble & Granite, exceptional craftsmanship begins with advanced technology.
Our machinery is the backbone of our production—designed to deliver accuracy, consistency, and efficiency from quarry to final finish.
We operate one of the most modern and integrated stone-processing facilities in Egypt, enabling us to meet global quality standards across blocks, slabs, and tiles.

generalUse.caption: 6 Overhead cranes with high quality to be able to hold blocks from our stock area
generalUse.cranesDesc: High-capacity cranes are designed for handling large marble and granite blocks safely and efficiently. Built to support heavy-duty lifting from our stockyard and ensure smooth internal logistics.
generalUse.forkliftDesc: Industrial forklifts optimized for transporting slabs, tiles, and raw blocks across the factory floor with precision and safety.

blocks.caption1:
Our machinery ensures accurate block cutting, squaring, and preparation prior to slab production.
This allows us to maintain consistent dimensions, reduce waste, and achieve premium-quality finishes.
blocks.caption2: Cutting and transforming blocks to slabs with different thickness (e.g. 2cm to 8cm)
blocks.gangsawsDesc: Heavy-duty gangsaws capable of cutting large marble and granite blocks with high precision. Designed for maximum stability and smooth sectioning to ensure uniform slab thickness.
blocks.blocksCuttersDesc: Advanced block-cutting machines engineered for high-speed performance and consistency across multiple stone types.
blocks.monofilosDesc: Precision monofilament machines used for accurate slicing, minimizing material loss while improving surface flatness.

slabs.caption: Polishing and treatment lines engineered to deliver premium finishes with consistent gloss, texture, and durability.
slabs.polishingLinesDesc: Capable of producing a wide range of finishes—polished, honed, brushed, leather, etc.—with thicknesses up to 8 cm.
slabs.risinLineDesc: A specialized resin line improving surface strength, durability, and visual appearance of slabs—especially premium stones.

tiles.caption: High-precision tile-cutting systems that transform slabs into tiles of any size for large-scale projects.
tiles.bridgeCuttersDesc: Bridge cutters are engineered for accuracy in producing tiles, steps, and customized stone formats.
tiles.tumblingMachineDesc: A dedicated line for antique, tumbled, and textured finishes used in landscaping and rustic architectural designs.
tiles.splittingStripsDesc: Strip-splitting machines for thin tiles, cladding pieces, and decorative stone elements.

stoneCreation.pageTitle: Stone Creations | Architectural & Landscaping Stone Products | Wadi Degla Marble
stoneCreation.metaDescription: Explore handcrafted stone creations made from Egyptian granite and limestone. Custom designs, premium finishes, artistic cuts, and durable architectural stone elements for luxury projects. Made by Wadi Degla Marble.
stoneCreation.landscapingDescription:
Our stone creations combine craftsmanship with the natural beauty of Egyptian marble and limestone. Each piece is precision-crafted to enhance exterior and interior spaces, whether for residential landscaping, luxury villas, public areas, or architectural restoration projects.
We offer a wide range of customizable stone elements designed for durability, elegance, and long-term performance.
stoneCreation.mosaicsDescription: Our stone mosaics come in various shapes and sizes for feature walls, pools, pathways, and artistic installations. All mosaics are cut with high precision to ensure consistent patterns and perfect alignment.
stoneCreation.cobbleStoneMasonryText: Our cobble stones provide a timeless aesthetic for walkways, plazas, gardens, and urban landscapes. Strong, slip-resistant, and weather-proof, they are ideal for high-traffic areas and outdoor designs requiring long-lasting durability.
stoneCreation.crownText: Architectural crown elements carved from solid limestone or marble, perfect for classical facades, columns, and decorative stone structures. These crowns add definition, depth, and an authentic architectural expression.
stoneCreation.handrailText: Stone handrails designed for balconies, staircases, terraces, and landscape projects. Their sculpted baluster design offers both structural stability and aesthetic harmony.
stoneCreation.keyText: Keystones add structural strength and architectural detail to arches, entrances, and decorative openings. Crafted with high precision, they bring a refined classical identity to any project.
stoneCreation.massiveStepsText: Our massive stone steps are ideal for grand entrances, garden pathways, and landscape transitions. Each piece is engineered for strength and slip-resistance, offering a premium upgrade for residential and commercial properties.
stoneCreation.planterText: Elegant stone planters designed to elevate outdoor and indoor spaces. Their natural finish complements greenery while offering exceptional durability against weather and moisture.
stoneCreation.poolCopingSetText: Custom pool coping stones ensuring safety, grip, and a premium finish around swimming pools. Designed for water resistance and long-term performance under heavy usage and outdoor conditions.
stoneCreation.squaredCrownText: A refined architectural crown variation with sharp geometrical details—ideal for modern or classical stone applications, column capitals, and façade enhancements.
stoneCreation.stoneSeatText: Minimalistic and contemporary stone seating solutions for parks, hotels, commercial spaces, and private gardens. Built for strength, longevity, and design coherence with landscape elements.
stoneCreation.wallstoneText: Natural wallstone cladding pieces ideal for feature walls, outdoor facades, fireplaces, and decorative partitions. Each piece offers texture, durability, and strong visual impact.
stoneCreation.mosaics2x2Text: Fine detailing for small-format mosaic applications, ideal for pools, decorative walls, and premium interiors.
stoneCreation.mosaics5x5Text: Versatile and balanced, suitable for both modern and traditional designs.
stoneCreation.mosaics10x10Text: A classic format with clean geometry, ideal for large spaces requiring uniformity.
stoneCreation.mosaicsHexagon5x5Text: Popular for modern interior and exterior design, adding texture and rhythm.
stoneCreation.mosaicsTrapezoid5x5Text: A dynamic pattern for creative architectural finishes.
stoneCreation.mosaics10x3Text: Slim-line modern mosaic ideal for feature walls and linear designs.
stoneCreation.mosaicsCircular5x5Text: Soft curves and dimensional depth for artistic wall expressions.
stoneCreation.mosaicsUpsAndDown10x10Text: 3D geometric styling creating visual depth and movement.
